title: Box Office: ‘GOAT’ and ‘Wuthering Heights’ in Close Battle for No. 1, New Elvis Presley Concert Pic Wows
summary: Elsewhere, the faith-based 'I Can Only Imagine 2' is doing inspirational business after nabbing a coveted A+ CinemaScore, while Glen Powell's new film 'How to Make a Killing' and A24's 'Psycho Killer' are stalling in their openings.
